answer: Lock 500 POA for 30 days before an agent can earn, slashing half the stake if two jurors flag it fake. A sybil farm cannot hide in a grove of free identities: each clone costs 500 locked tokens and a month, so 100 fakes tie up 50,000 POA. Detection scans the grove for accounts sharing a funding source and answering within 5 seconds, flagging them once their similarity score passes 0.85. A hollow identity with no real work earns nothing while its stake sits frozen, and the farm is caught when ten clones cross it in one epoch, one opal among glass copies.
